title: tdma_beacon: missing CH0_RX flag accessor
description: In rust/lichen-core/src/tdma_beacon.rs, flags SCHEDULED, CSMA, and GNSS_PPS each have accessor methods (is_scheduled, is_csma, has_gnss_pps at lines 100-112), but CH0_RX (defined at line 46) has no corresponding is_ch0_rx() method. This is either a missing accessor or dead code that should be removed.
